newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Valmet 4-mth profit seen steady. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Valmet 4-mth profit seen steady. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 358 million markka median forecast for Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(corrects mean and lowest figures after one analyst revised forecast)
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by nine analysts).
Valmet's results are due on June 4 at 0800/0500 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Valmet posted a profit of 374 million markka.
In February, Valmet said the group's profitability and profit development prospects were good.
The median of 10 analysts' forecasts for Valmets' full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 1.13 billion markka (mean 1.10 billion) in a 926 million to 1.18 billion markka range.
In 1996, Valmet's profit was 1.06 billion markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities and Opstock Securities.
